🔥 OpenBot | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a secure and auditable platform for deploying and managing AI agents that can perform real-world tasks within a user's own computing environment.
✨ Key Features: • AI agents with dedicated browsers, files, and tools • Action decision and recording via a central gateway • Runs on your own infrastructure (Docker Compose)
📖 Summary: OpenBot is an open-source platform for running AI agents, referred to as 'coworkers,' within your own infrastructure. It provides each agent with a dedicated browser, file access, and tools, all governed by a secure gateway that logs every action. This allows for trusted delegation of real work to AI agents.
